Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know before you explore incredible India.

What is TravelBharat?
TravelBharat is a free guide to explore India state by state. Find destinations, read about places, check timings and fees, and open them in Google Maps — all in one spot.
Is it free to use?
Yes, completely free. No sign-up, no subscription, no hidden charges. Just open the site and start exploring.
How do I find a place or state?
Use the search bar at the top to type any state or destination name. Results show up instantly as you type.
When is the best time to visit?
Click on any destination card — the detail panel shows the recommended months to visit along with entry fees and timings.
What kinds of places are listed?
Four categories: Heritage (forts & palaces), Nature (parks & beaches), Pilgrimage (temples & shrines), and Adventure (treks & hill stations). Each is colour-coded.
How do I get directions?
Open any place's detail panel and tap the View on map button. It opens the exact location directly in Google Maps.
Does it work on mobile?
Yes. The site is fully responsive and works on phones, tablets, and desktops. It also supports dark mode automatically.
Can I suggest a new place?
Absolutely. If you know a hidden gem or spot wrong info, contact us and we'll review and update it as soon as possible.
